**Stable ID:** `DATA-03.01` · **Record type:** Work Package · **Workstream:** 03 Modality coverage

Define identity, metadata and coverage rules for natural-language text and source-code datasets.

## Deliverables

- Modality profile for text and code
- Required metadata such as languages, scripts, tokenization notes and code languages

## Canonical artifact paths

- `docs/TAXONOMY.md`
- `schemas/modalities/text-code.schema.json`

## Source and evidence requirements

- Profile cites at least two public dataset documentation standards

## Acceptance criteria

- [ ] Profile lists required, optional and unknown-allowed fields
- [ ] Code datasets record repository-license provenance fields
- [ ] Validator enforces the profile

## Non-goals

- Measuring corpus statistics ourselves
